description:
A premium continete build with our coaster brake setup. S/M conti size frame. This is a great bike for biking. I built it for me, but maybe you is same as me and love super nice bikes.

Touring? yes. Groceries? yes. Trail? yes. Gravel… you get it…this bike is a beautiful blend of capability, simplicity and quality.

Parts. it’s got the good ones. White inustries top to bottom.. bracket, headset cranks, chainring. YUM!! Velocity, thomson, brooks, Paul…yum yum yum yum yum.

Also packed with our stuff. All the brass bits, our lightweight brazed stem, supple bi-plane fork, Oddmonē bars. Handbuild wheels (with a few test miles), our handbuilt coaster and cooling fins. Prepare yourself for comfortable capability.

Coaster curious? This continente is perfect…with boost spacing and disc brake mounts, you can easily convert to gears and handbrakes with minimal fuss.

This is a premium build that would cost a ton more even after scouring ebay and marketplace. Take atvantage of the complete bike package and pricing. If you made it here, we both know you’re a bike nerd. Do the math. Listen to your heart. Make dreams come true.
